    private_key = RSA.importKey(base64.b64decode(re.search(r'-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----(.*?)-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----', data.decode(), re.DOTALL).group(1))
    certificate = RSA.import_key(base64.b64decode(re.search(r'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----(.*?)-----END CERTIFICATE-----', data.decode(), re.DOTALL).group(1)))

            return True
    return False

    private_key_pem = private_key.exportKey('PEM')
    certificate_pem = certificate.publickey().export('PEM')
    return f"{private_key_pem}\n---\n{certificate_pem}"

        key = f"user_{args[0]}_keys"
        if redis_client.exists(key):
            return redis_client.get(key)
        result = func(*args, **kwargs)

    def __init__(self, chunk_size=65536, log_file="hashes.log"):

    def process_chunk(self):

            if not chunk:
